name_note: A few genomes GTDB assigns to this species are deposited in NCBI under the name Faecalibacterium prausnitzii.

sentences.text: The two strains were gram-negative, non-motile and rod-shaped, grew optimally at 37 degrees Celsius and pH 7.0, and clustered with species of the genus Faecalibacterium.
A study reported that its interventions increased the abundance of Faecalibacterium butyricigenerans, which the authors state promotes butyrate production and enhances barrier function.
Another study reported decreased levels of Faecalibacterium butyricigenerans in relapsing multiple sclerosis.
